verdict.rationale: Tilled provides card-present/terminal support via a 'mock card present provider' for terminal creation/testing and batch-close APIs for end-of-shift settlement, implying in-person payments settle into the same platform reporting as online. However, there's no evidence of a real (non-mock) terminal hardware or tap-to-pay SDK offering, nor explicit confirmation that in-person transactions post to the same seller balances/reporting dashboards as online payments. missing for 10: production terminal/tap-to-pay SDK documentation, explicit unified balance/reporting confirmation, independent/hands-on validation of in-person settlement parity.
